properties.description:
Requested in browser annotation 1 on 2026-10-20; keep Queued.

Problem
The Activity board Task stage dropdown mixes activity types (Need-analysis, Mocking, Planning, Design, Implementation, Verification, Review) with placement outcomes (Completed and Abandoned). The user wants this dropdown to contain activity types only and allows a second dropdown for placement.

Requested result
- Separate the two concepts in the owning model and their UI controls: activity type describes the work; placement describes Backlog, Queued, In progress, Waiting, Completed or Abandoned.
- Remove placement/outcome options from the activity-type control. Provide a distinct placement dropdown.
- Preserve the user's intended activity type when placement changes. Respect task invariants, parent-derived activity state and read-only constraints instead of bypassing them.
- Clarify existing Stage/Purpose terminology through the owning contracts; do not silently replace activity type with the different Purpose enumeration.
- Cover active and closed cards and the related Node editor controls so the separation is consistent.
- Reproduce the reported mixed options in recorded output and verify independent control behavior before delivering the change.

Evidence
Target: Task stage, div.activity-card-branch:nth-of-type(14) > article.activity-card > div.activity-card-metadata:nth-of-type(2) > select.task-stage:nth-of-type(1); point (560,453), viewport 1480x764.
The user's screenshot shows an Abandoned value in that activity control on a closed card.
Source page selected the Save bug: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/2a2f23d9-7d3e-4261-bc72-bbe306555937.json.
Include this task URL in implementation commit messages.

Progress, 2026-10-24
The unchanged owner and browser regressions reproduce the mixed choices and activity overwritten by closing/reopening. The user explicitly authorized migrating current records and saved snapshots, with no backward compatibility. Restore recorded prior activity where available; otherwise leave it unset. Preserve placement and review evidence. Implement and validate the seven activity choices and independent placement controls.

2026-10-24 implementation: c957885 separates the seven activity types from six placements in the board and Node editor, preserves activity when closing/reopening tasks, and derives parent activity from children. Focused domain/review and browser recordings pass. User-authorized data migration completed at revision 1045: all 406 current terminal activity values, captured review tasks, and saved historical revisions converted; all generation hashes and converted task contracts verified. No compatibility reader or migration code remains active. Completed: focused owner/consumer checks and exact browser recordings pass, including the affected scenarios in both full browser runs. Disposable UI screenshots were inspected. The overall checkpoint follow-up is tracked separately on the native Windows worker task.

Final checkpoint, 2026-10-24, commit 6a04fdf: build and type checks passed (1,164 authored files, zero violations); all 668 non-browser tests passed. This task's affected browser scenarios passed and UI screenshots were inspected where applicable. The full browser run passed 292/294, with separate native-worker and review-acceptance failures retained as queued investigations. Both failed cases passed unchanged in isolation. Live application restarted successfully. Detailed report: .harness/overnight-verification-20261024.json.
